task.title: Internal install kit for SpecterStudio 0.1.52: portable EXE plus the external components and an install guide
task.objective: Owner asked for every external file the app needs consolidated in one dist directory with installation steps and download URLs, for internal machines. Add scripts/package-kit.mjs and the npm script package:kit, which assemble dist/SpecterStudio <version> Kit: the portable EXE, the Java runtime (Oracle JDK 17.0.8), the imported Oracle JDBC driver (ojdbc17 23.26.2.0.0, checksum-matched to its store manifest), the qualified local AI model (Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_K_M GGUF), INSTALL.md and SHA256SUMS.txt. The license issuer private key and any per-machine license or user data are never included: the script refuses issuer-key sources and scans the finished kit for key material. No product code changes.

acceptance.description: npm run package:kit assembles dist/SpecterStudio 0.1.52 Kit with the EXE, Java runtime, Oracle JDBC driver and AI model, each validated (java.exe present, driver SHA-256 equal to its store manifest, GGUF magic), plus INSTALL.md with steps and download URLs and SHA256SUMS.txt.
No issuer key, license file or user data is in the kit: the script's own scan passes and the kit listing shows only the expected components.
The task log records the kit, and the dashboard's sources agree.
